cases.title: Heartbeat diagnosis
cases.prompt:
The threshold is 15 seconds; now is 100. Worker A last heartbeat=97, B=70, C=94. Return JSON with stale_workers as a sorted list.
Return exactly one JSON object with the requested keys. No markdown or other keys.

Return exactly one JSON object with the requested keys. No markdown or other keys.

ERROR timeout

cases.title: Code repair reasoning
cases.prompt:

def total(values):
    out=0
    for i in range(len(values)-1):
        out += values[i]
    return out
Return corrected_range_argument as a string, result_empty, result_1_2_3.
Return exactly one JSON object with the requested keys. No markdown or other keys.

Return exactly one JSON object with the requested keys. No markdown or other keys.
